description: React + Tailwind dark-themed dashboard for the AI Video Clipper (scaffold).
//overrides: Both are transitive, dev-only and reached through tooling we do not choose the version of:
js-yaml via eslint -> @eslint/eslintrc, nanoid via postcss. Each pin is a patched release
inside the major its dependent already asks for (eslintrc wants ^4.1.0, postcss ^3.3.11), so
this is not a version bump - `npm ci` resolves the same tree and `npm run build` emits
byte-identical output. Unlike the brace-expansion advisory this replaces, both had clean
fixes: that one had no fix that was not worse than the finding, which is why the CI gate is
--audit-level=critical. The gate is a floor, not a claim that high is acceptable - prefer
fixing an advisory over widening the gate, and drop an entry here once the dependent ships a
range that already excludes the vulnerable versions.
